title: The Violet Tower
brief: An apprentice restores a purple tower beacon by learning a word of mercy, finding the moon key and answering a guardian. A four-room exploration quest, not a combat game.

rooms.name: Violet Court
rooms.description: The tower's violet lamps are fading. Ione remembers how to reach the crown.

rooms.name: Whisper Library
rooms.description: Between two old shelves rests the key that opens the moon seal.

rooms.name: Moon Seal
rooms.description: A guardian asks what strength must protect. Return to Ione if you do not know.

rooms.name: Crown Chamber
rooms.description: The beacon awaits a steady hand. Light it and shelter the valley.

items.name: Moon key
items.description: The library key fits the moon seal. It is not consumed.

args.text: The library keeps the moon key. If the guardian tests you, remember: strength must protect mercy.

args.label: Lift the moon key
args.text: A silver key rests on the reading desk.

args.label: Restore the violet beacon
args.text: The beacon glows violet again. The valley has a light to guide it home.

quests.title: Restore the violet beacon
quests.description: Find the key, learn the word and earn the guardian's passage.
